title.en: An Act Appropriating Ten thousand Pesos for the Reforestation of Uncultivated Public Lands.

text.en:
The sum of ten thousand pesos, or so much thereof as may be necessary, is hereby appropriated,
out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the Bureau of Forestry, for
expenditure as may be deemed necessary for carrying on the work of the reforestation of uncultivated public
lands and on the lands known as friar lands not reserved or set aside for other purposes.

The sum hereinbefore appropriated shall be available for the Bureau of Forestry until expended
for the purposes above mentioned, or until the Secretary of the Interior shall notify the Insular Treasurer that
the disbursement of said sum is to be discontinued.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, February 24, 1916.
